name: author-skill
job: Create or revise an Agent Skill package: job, description, method, references, contract.

inScope: Creating a new listing skill package for one requestable job
Rewriting a skill that is too broad, vague, unused, or mis-classified
Deciding listing skill vs reference depth and constraint-pack placement
Authoring the capability contract and honest qualification record for the package
Writing discovery-quality descriptions with near-miss discipline
outOfScope: Installing or syncing the catalog into a runtime (root SKILL.md / INSTALL.md)
Docs-only content with no executable agent job

inputs: The user's job or gap the skill must cover
Existing package content or an empty package to fill
Repository conventions from AGENTS.md and docs/MODEL.md
outputs: skills/<id>/SKILL.md with name+description frontmatter and procedure body
Optional references/, scripts/, assets/ depth reachable from the body
capability.json contract and qualification.json record for the package
Fresh catalog.json and green npm test result

permissions: write access to the target repository (or a PR path into it)

failureSemantics: check.mjs reports broken links, schema violations, stale catalogs, and forbidden markers; acceptance fails closed until the package passes npm test with a fresh catalog and the description selects for the right ask while abstaining on near-misses.

outcome.observable: The revised package passes npm test with a fresh catalog, local links resolve, the capability contract validates, and the description selects for the right ask and abstains on near-misses.
